operators.customDisplayName: Load 2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv via pd.read_csv (comma delimiter, header in first row, UTF-8 inferred) to get annual counts of reports by type including 'Other'.

operatorProperties.code:
def process(reportsByType) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType.copy()
    # Real header is on row index 1
    df.columns = df.iloc[1].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df.iloc[2:].copy()

    # Keep year range and coerce numerics (remove commas)
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].between(2001, 2024)].copy()

    for c in ['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')

    df['total'] = df[['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']].sum(axis=1, skipna=False)
    df['otherShare'] = df['Other'] / df['total']
    any_year = bool((df['otherShare'] > 0.5).fillna(False).any())

    return pd.DataFrame([{'answer': 'Yes' if any_year else 'No'}])

operators.customDisplayName: Clean reportsByType table by promoting row 2 (index 1) to header (Year, Fraud, Identity Theft, Other), dropping non-data rows; parse comma-formatted counts to numeric; filter Year between 2001-2024 inclusive; compute total = Fraud+Identity Theft+Other and flag whether any year has Other/total > 0.5; output single-row DataFrame with column 'answer' as Yes/No.
